::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [<i>c</i>. January 1878]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell
:::

My dear [Bath Brick](people/person_1865.qmd)[^1]

Skelton was poet laureat to Henry VIII & Rector of Diss in Norfolk.  I am afraid he was not a very respectable person & I do not know his poems.  Your ‘Tact’ is the chosen one this time[^2]

Yours very sincerely

Arachne

---

[^1]: 'Bath Brick' made her first appearance in  *MP* in May 1876 as a participant in the [Spider](organizations/other_116.qmd) competitions, and continued to take part until 1896.
[^2]: ‘Define Tact’ was one of the Spider questions for December 1877.  Bath Brick’s answer was chosen for publication in the issue of February 1878.
